name: Grain
tagline: Ready-made website for bespoke furniture makers
description: Grain is a website template for bespoke furniture and kitchen makers, with a hero where visitors drag a line between the technical drawing and the finished kitchen, furniture categories with prices per linear metre, a kitchen planner where visitors pick a layout, set wall lengths and fronts and see a top view plan with an indicative price, a wall of material samples hanging on rings, a four-stage process set on dimension lines, client reviews with project photos, a FAQ with structured data and a projects page with city and floor area. Forest green, charcoal and warm off-white with Barlow Condensed headings give the website a precise, workshop character. Replace the copy, prices, figures, photos, reviews and legal pages with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with a draggable before and after line between the drawing and the finished kitchen
Furniture cards with prices per linear metre
Three furniture pages: kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms and home offices
Kitchen planner: I, L, U or island layout, wall lengths and fronts, with a live top view plan and indicative price
Material samples for fronts and worktops, styled as tags on a ring
Four-stage process from measurement to installation on dimension lines
Client reviews with project photos, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Projects page with eight interiors, city and floor area
FAQ with native disclosure widgets and FAQPage structured data
